answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 37920 Country: India Title: Intention of Ihram for Umra Question: Presently, working as an expatriate in Dubai. Intending of Umra, so going by air to my brothers house in Jedda. I will take some rest and then do umra from there. So should I have to put the Ahram from Dubai or from Jeddah. Please explain. Answer ID: 37920 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 661/566/B=1433) You should wear Ihram from Dubai. You can take rest in Jeddah in your brother’s room even in the state of ihram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
